name: Trading-ML-LLM System API
capabilities: Precision Strategy: Dynamic ATR stops (1.0x - 1.5x) and targets (2.5x - 3.0x)
Ensemble Model: Dual-probability (Baseline + Trained) with agreement logic
SimpleMem: Historical pattern matching and confidence scoring
Trailing Stops: Automatic move-to-breakeven at 50% target reach
Multi-Provider: Support for Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini

structured_analysis.description: Returns ALL ranked trades with full technical context and allocation strategy

schema.ranked_trades: Array<{symbol, probability, entry, limit_entry, rr_ratio, setup_score, expected_profit}>

chat_qa.description: Accepts free-form questions with full system context injection

generate_report.description: Generate and save LLM analysis report to markdown/JSON

generate_discovery.description: Generate and save /api/llm discovery content as markdown report

list_reports.description: List available LLM analysis reports with metadata

agent_instructions: 1. Priority: Recommend BUY only when RR Ratio > 2.0 and Baseline Prob > 65%. 2. Validation: Cross-reference Baseline Prob with Learning Model Prob. 3. Risk: Check 'Open Positions' before suggesting new allocations. 4. Entry: Favor 'Limit Entry' prices for high-volatility (ATR) setups.
